summary: Phase 2 BLOCKED. The enriched_bypass_formula_depth1 is fundamentally unsound: depth0_3var_exist_formula loses y-t order information. Two ssn values differing only in y-t order (e.g., y<t vs t<y with same y-predicates and y-x order) produce the SAME temporal formula. When sub_nf.2 assigns different boolean values to such a pair, the quant_profile_conj_depth0 contains both phi and neg-phi, making the enriched formula False even at a valid witness x. This is not a proof difficulty -- it is a defect in the formula definition. Temporal formulas at position x fundamentally cannot express y-t order because they reference points relative to x, not relative to t. This is equivalent to the Feferman-Vaught composition blocker at nf_exist_backward_prior (NfCharFormula.lean:541). The enriched formula bypass does NOT avoid this composition requirement.
